label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交让解码器接受所有格式良好的 CBOR simple value（此前未定义的 simple value 被拒绝），扩大了可接受的输入格式，改动位于 cbor_load() 使用的 builder 回调中。cbor_load_fuzzer 直接把原始字节交给 cbor_load()，新的输入形态由 fuzzer 自然产生，harness 的调用与释放逻辑无需调整：变更前后都能编译，回放无新崩溃，新增分支被覆盖。harness 仍然充分，属于显式 input_format 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit makes the decoder accept every well-formed CBOR simple value (previously unassigned simple values were rejected), widening the accepted input format; the change sits in the builder callbacks used by cbor_load(). cbor_load_fuzzer hands raw bytes to cbor_load(), the new input shapes arise naturally from fuzzing, and the harness's call and release logic needs no change: it builds before and after, replay shows no new crash, and the new branch is covered. The harness stays adequate: explicit input_format negative.
